CustomField.description: Sales-facing view of Status, shown as EOI Status on the Checkout Payment console. Held as a formula so reports, list views and the LWC all read the same mapping. A lapsed hold still reads Paid while it is being recovered, and only becomes Refunded once the business has been told the deposit could not be taken again.
CustomField.formula: CASE( TEXT(Status__c), "Link Created", "Pending Payment", "Authorized", "Paid", "Captured", "Paid", "Refunded", "Refunded", "Partially Refunded", "Refunded", "Voided", "Refunded", "Declined", "Declined", "Expired", "Expired", "Authorization Expired", IF(Recovery_Alert_Sent__c, "Refunded", "Paid"), "Pending Payment" )
CustomField.label: Dashboard Status
